body:
WHAT
Long silent work shows that it is going on.
- Engine: a silent-reasoning rung in the turn loop. After each model call that ends in tool calls, reasoning written with no user-visible text adds to a per-turn count; a call with text resets it. When the count reaches 8,000 characters, the next request (the tool results) carries one reminder asking the model to tell the user, in one short sentence, what it is doing, and to keep planning brief. It fires once per silent stretch: after it fires it re-arms only when the model has written text again. Root sessions only (a child's text is not the user's view), and never for the silently streamed self-verify answer.
- Desktop: the live reasoning block's summary reads "reasoning · <elapsed> · ~<tokens> tokens" and is refreshed whenever its text reaches the page (once per frame at most); it keeps the final figures when the block ends. A restored block shows "reasoning · ~<tokens> tokens" (no time: none was watched). The token figure is the renderer's existing estimateTokens (the mirrored CHARS_PER_TOKEN) through formatTokens. The now-line (shared strip and tiled panes, one shared helper) prints its timer with formatElapsed, so eight minutes read "8m12s", not "492s".

WHY
Field test 2026-09-23, findings M-06 and R-3. From 18:06:29 to 18:30:12 the user saw no text at all: the model only reasoned, and the collapsed reasoning block said "reasoning" the whole time. SECTION_COMMUNICATION already asks for a sentence before the first tool call; nothing reacted when the model did not. The wrap-up nudge and the stall detector both need tool-call patterns, not silence.

WHERE
engine/core/src/runtime/session.ts — SILENT_REASONING_REMINDER (a registry prompt, group 3), the rung in the tool branch of the turn loop, thinkingLength(). app/renderer/modules/stream.js — reasoningLabel(), createReasoningEl(), writeReasoning(), finishReasoning(). app/renderer/modules/views.js — nowActivityTail(), renderNowText(); app/renderer/modules/tabs.js renderPaneNowLine() uses the same helper; app/renderer/modules/landing.js onSessionRestored() labels a restored block.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. (fs) A real engine on the scripted provider: two tool rounds, each reasoning 5,000 characters with no text. The reminder is in the request after the second round (the count passed 8,000), exactly once, and not in the request after the first. A third silent round does not add it again.
2. (fs) Text resets the stretch: silent 9,000 → reminder; then a round with text; then silent 9,000 → the reminder comes back once. A single round reasoning 20,000 characters WITH text never gets it.
3. (ui) In the real app, a live reasoning block's summary shows the elapsed time and a ~token estimate that grows with its text, and keeps them after a tool call ends it; a restored block shows the estimate and no time; the now-line reads formatElapsed's form.
